interpretation: The anomaly detector learns benign behavior only. Scenario-holdout attack recall measures whether unseen attack flows look unusual, while held-out benign FPR measures sensitivity to benign distribution shift.
limitations: Isolation Forest detects unusual feature combinations; it does not identify the cause or prove that a flow is malicious.
A low calibration FPR can become much higher on a held-out network scenario if normal traffic changes.
All data still originates from one historical benchmark. External and current traffic validation remains necessary.
